annotations.title: Compare one pair across every bank

description: One currency pair across ALL institutions at once — 'what does each central bank say USD/EUR is?', 'spread between official USD/LKR rates'. Returns every covered bank's latest official rate for the pair plus { min, max, median, spread_bps } over fresh sources. Banks are never mixed: derived rates are cross-computed within each bank's own table. API key required (free tier). Methodology: https://allratestoday.com/official-rates-methodology/

source.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.
